correctness.rationale: For the multiplication action of B=eAe on A, both inclusions in AB=Ae follow from be=b and e∈B, and (1−e)B=0. Right multiplication by e projects onto Ae with kernel A(1−e), and 1 does not lie in Ae for e≠1. Thus A is not unital over B and cannot be a direct sum of ordinary copies of B. Even without a specified module convention, every finite sum in the proposed B-linear spanning argument lies in Ae. For finite-vertex KP algebras the unit is the sum of all vertex idempotents, each nonzero (for instance in the infinite-path representation, since there are no sources). A vertex outside H witnesses p_H≠1, and heredity makes the hereditary-subgraph subalgebra the p_H corner. If H is the whole vertex set, B=A and A is free of rank one. For unital V, a⊗v=ae⊗v shows the tensor identity with inverse induced by inclusion. The adjunction follows by evaluating at e⊗v and extending via ae⊗v↦aψ(v), which is well defined since ψ takes values in eM. The disjoint loops give the claimed proper saturated hereditary example. In Nguyen v1's separate rank-two example s_vp_H=0, so s_v⊗1 vanishes by exactly the balancing identity. The CK vertex relation also rules out the assertion that all path/ghost monomials are independent when there is branching. Exactness and flatness of the corrected bimodule have not been inferred. The mathematical diagnosis concerns v1; the bibliographic remark that only v1 is listed is no longer current.
residual_risks: Only the finite-vertex unital assertion is decided here; this does not decide exactness, the local-unit version, or other theorems in the source.

originality.rationale: The distinct same-day Resultary record c4e26c67e759 gives the very same diagnosis of Nguyen v1 Theorem 3.5, the identical two-loop-component counterexample with the same unit obstruction, and the general idempotent tensor repair. This is substantive coverage, not inferred chronology. The universal finite-vertex wording adds the immediate consequence that every proper finite-vertex corner has p_H≠1 and excludes every outside vertex from Ap_H. The displayed rank-two zero vector is a useful source locator but is itself the sibling's general balancing identity applied to s_vp_H=0. The additional restriction functor p_H(-) is already used in the motivating preprint's Proposition 8.5. Taken together the differences do not establish a distinct scientific correction of the frozen scope. This does not adjudicate which same-day entry came first.
residual_risks: Best-of-knowledge, based on positive overlap evidence. Same-day chronology and full v1-to-v2 editorial relationship were not established; no conclusion rests on either.
